text:
Maria Chen: heads up — noticed the dashboard p50/p95/p99 for /v1/generate jumped after yesterday's routing tweak. looks like the tail moved even though median is stable
Kevin O'Leary: saw that too. can you paste the slice you used? timestamp window?
Maria Chen: pulled 10m window around the incident, grouped by endpoint path and client_id. median flat, p95 up ~40ms, p99 up ~120ms for route=fast-fallback
Samir Patel: hmm, route=fast-fallback is weight-shifted to a cheaper variant. that variant was added to quota-fallback rules last week — could be queuing change
Jess Rodriguez: quick note: our console rollup aggregates by logical endpoint name unless endpoint tag is explicitly present. maybe routing policy added a synthetic endpoint tag?
Maria Chen: interesting — the requests are showing endpoint=/v1/generate but telemetry shows route=fast-fallback and endpoint_tag missing in some buckets
Kevin O'Leary: if endpoint_tag is missing, rollup uses route as the key for percentile calculation. that could explain the sudden tail if mix of clients ended up in same rollup
TelemetryBot: reminder: sample origin metadata emitted by gateway v2.4 requires the `x-endpoint-id` header to be copied into telemetry. Missing header -> fallback to route id
Samir Patel: quick repro query I ran: `SELECT percentiles(lat_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM traces WHERE route='fast-fallback' AND ts>1678000000` — shows p50 stable, p95/p99 jump. when I add `AND endpoint_tag='generate'` the p99 goes back down
Jess Rodriguez: sounds like a provenance problem. console UX shows endpoint breakdown toggle but it only flips client-visible label, not how backend aggregates. confusing
Maria Chen: can we make two small changes: 1) mark route-level rollups as "mixed-endpoint" in the legend when endpoint_tag missing, 2) make a telemetry alert when sample-origin header is missing >0.5% of requests per minute
Kevin O'Leary: +1. Also we should update docs for rollout gating: if you introduce a variant that doesn't emit endpoint_id we should block canary until header parity confirmed
Samir Patel: agree on gating. also propose fallback policy change: prefer variant that preserves telemetry headers even if slightly higher cost
Jess Rodriguez: for console UX, I can put a tooltip that explains aggregation key precedence (endpoint_tag -> route -> fallback) and show a small badge when fallback used
Maria Chen: who's owning the telemetry alert? Samir?
Samir Patel: I can own the alert, will add a metric and a PagerDuty tag 'telemetry-missing-header' and bake into rollout checklist
Kevin O'Leary: i'll draft the gating PR to disallow canary if header parity fails. will link to Samir's alert
Jess Rodriguez: I'll mock a legend state that includes mixed-endpoint banner and tooltip. will drop screenshots in this thread
Maria Chen: thanks all. action items: Samir alert, Kevin gating PR, Jess UX mock, ops verify historic rollup reaggregation for the last 7 days. I'll run the reagg and post numbers tomorrow
TelemetryBot: alert created: metric `telemetry.header_missing_pct` with threshold 0.5% in 1m buckets — owners: samir@redwood, oncall-team
Kevin O'Leary: awesome. small followup: do we want the console to show p50/p95/p99 per-client by default or keep it per-endpoint? default per-endpoint is less noisy but hides hotspots
Maria Chen: let's keep per-endpoint default with a quick "drill into client" CTA in the p99 cell. UX should make discovery easy
Jess Rodriguez: noted. will include drill CTA in mock
Samir Patel: reagg ran — historic p99 for route=fast-fallback drops by ~90ms when grouped by endpoint_id. posting a couple plots in #eng-platform-visuals
Maria Chen: great, wrap up: block the next canary until gating PR merges. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
